description: Dell 14S laptop has been launched in India with Intel Core 5 and Core 7 Series 3 processors. It comes with a 14-inch display with up to 2.8K resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. It is offered in four colour options and features an aluminium chassis. It is claimed to deliver up to 21 hours of Netflix streaming on a single charge.
title: Dell 14S Launched in India With Up to Intel Core 7 350 Processor: Price, Specifications

description: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority has upgraded Project Ensemble to support round-the-clock real-value tokenised settlements through its EnsembleTX project. The initiative aims to facilitate international fund transfers, tokenised investments and treasury management. The regulator also plans to extend its trials to regulated stablecoins, following tests involving tokenised bonds, money market funds and bank deposits. Meanwhile, HSBC CEO Georges Elhedery revealed that its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, RedCoin, attracted 50,000 users within 10 days of launch.
title: Hong Kong Pushes for 24/7 Tokenised Settlement, Plans Stablecoin Trials

description: Garmin's ECG feature is designed to help smartwatch users check their heart rhythm and look for signs of atrial fibrillation. Compatible watches use built-in sensors to record the heart's electrical activity, with results available on the device and through Garmin Connect. Users can also access their previous readings and create reports to share with doctors. The feature is intended for adults aged 22 and above and requires updated smartwatch software and the latest version of the Garmin Connect app.
title: Garmin ECG App Expands to India, Supports 30-Second Heart Rhythm Readings

description: Anthropic has introduced Message Threads in public beta on the Claude Platform. It can reduce the response latency for long-running AI agent sessions by eliminating the need to resend the entire conversation history with every API request. Anthropic says the feature is enabled by default for most Claude Code users. The company says that, with the new feature, requests containing between 500,000 and 1 million tokens have reportedly seen a median time to first token (TTFT) reduction of approximately 35 percent.
title: Anthropic Announces Message Threads in Public Beta to Reduce Latency for Long-Running Sessions

description: HP has introduced two 14-inch OLED laptops in India, with prices starting at Rs. 86,000 for the ProBook 4 G2iS and Rs. 1,09,999 for the OmniBook 5. The ProBook is listed with up to 32GB of RAM, 1TB of storage and a 70Wh battery, while the OmniBook weighs 1.16kg and claims up to 42 hours of local video playback. Both models use up to Intel Core 7 processors, but have different NPU ratings, camera features and business security features.
title: HP OmniBook 5, ProBook 4 G2iS AI PCs Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: Blockchain investigator ZachXBT has increased his estimate of a suspected cryptocurrency theft involving an unnamed Western European financial institution to more than $133 million. The latest findings include an additional $27 million in withdrawals from centralised exchanges and four newly identified wallet addresses. ZachXBT suspects the institution may be concealing the incident, while alleging that at least $30 million has already been laundered through stablecoin conversions, instant exchanges and cross-chain transfers. He believes the suspected attacker is French-speaking and is unlikely to be North Korea’s Lazarus Group.
title: ZachXBT Flags Possible Cover-Up as Crypto Theft Estimates Cross $133 Million

description: Oppo Watch 5 has been spotted in a real-life image, revealing the design of the smartwatch. Song Yuqi, a member of the music group, i-dle, was reportedly seen wearing the upcoming smartwatch in public. The leaked image reveals the design of the wearable. It appears to have a square-shaped dial, housing a touchscreen surrounded by relatively thin bezels. It might sport a metal frame, finished in silver. The image also shows the Oppo Watch 5 with a purple band. A rotating crown also appears on the right side of the smartwatch. Further, the report highlights that the Oppo Watch 5 will boast an “ultra-thin” design. The wearable is said to weigh about 27g and measure 9.2mm in thickness. On top of this, the Oppo Watch 5 will reportedly sport an aerospace-grade aluminum alloy mid-frame.
title: Oppo Watch 5 Design Spotted in Leaked Real-Life Image Ahead of Imminent Launch

description: The upcoming Redmi smartphone could bring several changes over the Turbo 5 Max, including a larger display and a higher refresh rate. A tipster has also pointed to a new screen design with narrow bezels and BT.2020 colour gamut support. Other expected specifications include a battery exceeding 10,000mAh, an ultrasonic in-display fingerprint sensor and IP68 and IP69 ratings. The handset could launch in China around January before reaching international markets under a different name.
title: Redmi Turbo 6 Max Could Get 7-Inch Display, 185Hz Refresh Rate

description: Corning on Tuesday announced that its new manufacturing facility is now operational in Maharashtra’s Pune. The US-based company, which is known for supplying protective glass covers for flagship and mid-range smartphones, claims that its new manufacturing plant will help it serve the needs of the region better. Further, the company said that it will supply its optical connectivity products, such as optical fibre, outdoor and indoor cables, fibre optic closures, and indoor and outdoor cable assemblies, for data centres and telecommunications network applications.
title: Corning Opens Pune Plant to Manufacture Optical Connectivity Products for Data Centres

description: Motorola announced festive prices across its smartphone portfolio as part of the ongoing Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale 2026 on Tuesday. According to the company, its offers cover smartphones across price segments, ranging from entry-level models like the Moto G06 to the flagship Motorola Signature. Motorola also offers price cuts as well as bank offers on models from its Edge and G-series lineups, across multiple RAM and onboard storage configurations.
title: Motorola Signature, Edge 70 Series and Moto G Phones Get Festive Discounts on Flipkart

description: THORChain suspended cryptocurrency swaps across 10 blockchain networks after an Ethereum transaction error resulted in an additional 10 ETH payout. The issue followed a one-block reorganisation on October 31, which caused a deposit to disappear from Ethereum’s transaction history after THORChain had already processed it. The protocol’s automated balance checks detected the discrepancy and triggered an emergency halt. Chainalysis said the disruption also delayed transfers connected to the October 29 Binance hack.
title: THORChain Mistakenly Refunds 10 ETH, Disrupting Binance Hackers’ Transfers

description: Asus has launched the ProArt P16 in India. The latest laptop comes with a 16-inch display, an Nvidia RTX Spark processor, long battery backup, and more. Check out our first impressions to learn more about Asus's latest laptop.
title: Asus ProArt P16 First Impressions

description: The collaboration with Cathedral brings external researchers into OpenAI's efforts to address vulnerabilities. The company is also changing its bug bounty programme, with payouts for critical reports set to rise more than four times, although revised amounts have not been disclosed. The announcement follows an earlier exercise that involved a quarter of OpenAI's product engineers using Codex to investigate security issues. OpenAI has pledged $1 billion (roughly Rs. 9,500 crore) in subsidised access for frontline cyber defenders over six months.
title: OpenAI Teams Up With Cathedral to Find Security Flaws, Raises Critical Bug Bounty Rewards

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra dummy unit shows a redesigned rear camera bar. The camera arrangement appears to have been repositioned higher on the rear panel, potentially leaving additional space for magnetic accessories. The upcoming phone is said to measure 163.76 x 78.25 x 7.97mm. For comparison, the Galaxy S26 Ultra reportedly measures 163.6 x 78.1 x 7.9mm.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Leaked Dummy Unit Reveals Redesigned Camera Bar, Dimensions

description: Vivo T5 5G was recently launched in India with a clear objective of offering the most balanced user experience under Rs. 40,000. Available at a starting price of Rs. 34,999, the Vivo T5 5G manages to fulfil its promises to some extent. The smartphone captures quite aesthetic-looking, social media-ready pictures with its 50-megapixel rear camera on the back. However, its low-light camera performance is just passable. It performs well, but there are phones that are known to offer better outright performance. Where it really excels is battery life and display, elevating the daily user experience.
title: Vivo T5 5G Review: Come for the Display, Stay for the Impressive Battery Life

description: Vivo V80 FE has appeared on the company's official Philippines website. As per the listing, the Vivo V80 FE features a 6.59-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate and up to 3,000 nits of local peak brightness. It has a MediaTek Dimensity 7400-Turbo chipset. It has a 7,000mAh battery with 90W wired fast charging support. It received certification from Thailand's NBTC authority.
title: Vivo V80 FE Listed on Official Website Revealing Specifications, Colourways; Spotted on NBTC Website

description: Asus has announced a Diwali sale ahead of the festive season, offering several laptop models across categories at special discounted prices. The sale includes laptops from its Zenbook, Vivobook, ROG, TUF and ExpertBook series.
title: Asus Diwali Sale Offers Announced With Deals on Zenbook, Vivobook, ROG, TUF and ExpertBook Series Laptops

description: Bitcoin traded below $77,000 on Tuesday as cryptocurrency markets faced renewed selling pressure and cautious investor sentiment. Data shared by WazirX showed $365.90 million in liquidations across more than 93,000 traders, with long positions accounting for 83.8 percent of the total. Institutional ETF outflows, uncertainty surrounding US economic developments, and expectations of a possible December rate hike also weighed on the market.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $77,000 as Crypto Liquidations Cross $366 Million

description: The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max is an ambitious flagship with one of the most versatile camera systems available in the Indian market. It packs three 200-megapixel rear cameras, which are not merely about resolution; they consistently produce pleasing photographs across landscapes, zoom shots, and challenging lighting. The 6.78-inch LTPO AMOLED display is among the finest we have seen on an Oppo phone, while the Dimensity 9600 Pro keeps the experience fast and responsive. Battery life is another major strength, with the 8,000mAh battery pack comfortably lasting beyond a day of use. However, video recording is less dependable than the still-camera experience, and Oppo's AI features don't quite match its flagship ambitions. At Rs. 1,99,999, the asking price is the biggest obstacle to recommending an otherwise excellent smartphone.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max Review: A Photography Monster With One Catch

description: Asus ProArt P16 and ProArt P14 were launched in India on Tuesday. The latest laptops from the Taiwanese company are aimed at content creators and AI developers. Both models are powered by NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X computing platforms and feature OLED touchscreens with 120Hz refresh rates and Pantone Validation. The ProArt P16 sports a 16-inch 4K display and up to 128GB of unified memory, while the ProArt P14 is equipped with a 14-inch 3K panel and 24GB of memory. Alongside the laptops, Asus has also launched the ProArt Mouse MD301 and ProArt Keyboard KD300.
title: Asus ProArt P16, ProArt P14 Launched in India With RTX Spark N1X Chip, Up to 128GB Unified Memory

description: Apple sent out Threat Notifications to multiple users in Germany, starting October 29, notifying them of a spyware attack. Financial Times reports that Germany’s Federal Office for Information Security (BSI) issued a notice to Bundestag lawmakers and other public figures that they should assume their iPhone has been compromised as part of a government-backed mercenary spyware attack if they received a Threat Notification from Apple over the weekend. However, Germany was not the only country where users received Apple’s Threat Notifications. TechCrunch reports that the latest batch of Threat Notifications was sent to users in 99 countries.
title: Apple Notifies iPhone Users in 99 Countries of Spyware Attacks as Germany Launches Investigation: Report

description: The Samsung Galaxy A58 5G has been in the rumour mill recently. Last month, a tipster claimed that it would be launched in select global markets, including India, in 2027. Now, the purported handset has been spotted on a certification website. The listing offers an early look at its charging capabilities. As per the listing, the Samsung Galaxy A58 5G could feature the same charging speed as the Galaxy A57 5G, which is its predecessor.
title: Samsung Galaxy A58 Reportedly Receives 3C Certification, Revealing Charging Speed

description: OnePlus Turbo 7 will be powered by the unreleased Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 chipset, according to a tipster. This could enable a notable performance upgrade over the previous generation standard model. The OnePlus Turbo 7 will reportedly also feature a 200-megapixel camera on the back. However, similar to its predecessor, the handset could continue to miss out on a periscope telephoto rear camera. Further, the smartphone is said to sport a new display that refreshes at up to 185Hz in specific scenarios and up to 165Hz otherwise. It might also feature a glass body.
title: OnePlus Turbo 7 Launch Timeline, Key Specifications Surface Ahead of Expected Debut

description: The Borderlands franchise has surpassed 100 million copies sold, Gearbox Software has announced. The series hit the sales milestone just over a year after the launch of Borderlands 4. Gearbox also confirmed it was planning to release major new content as part of the second year of post-launch updates for Borderlands 4.
title: Borderlands Franchise Crosses 100 Million Units Sold a Year After Borderlands 4 Launch

description: Samsung is reportedly preparing a limited initial rollout for its first AI smart glasses, with South Korea and the US set to receive the product before other markets. The company is yet to finalise pricing, while availability in Japan, China and Europe remains unconfirmed. The glasses will run on Google's Android XR platform and use Gemini AI for features such as translation and navigation. Samsung has also worked with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker on the eyewear designs.
title: Samsung Intelligent Eyewear Launch Timeline Surfaces Online

description: Bend Studio, the Oregon-based developer behind Days Gone, is reportedly set to reveal its next project sometime in 2027. The studio is also reportedly planning to launch the game next year. According to a report, the game is a third-person co-op title, but it is not a live service project. Bend Studio released Days Gone in 2019.
title: Days Gone Developer Bend Studio Will Reportedly Reveal and Release Its Next Game in 2027

description: The Oppo Reno 17 series is confirmed to launch in China this month. While the company has yet to announce a launch date, it has begun taking pre-orders for its upcoming lineup, which is expected to comprise the Oppo Reno 17 and the Reno 17 Pro. Ahead of their anticipated debut, a tipster has leaked key specifications of both the upcoming handsets. The standard Reno 17 could get an 8,000mAh-class battery and a Snapdragon chipset, whereas the Pro variant is said to use a MediaTek processor and a smaller battery.
title: Oppo Reno 17, Reno 17 Pro Specifications, Colour Options Tipped Ahead of China Launch

description: OnePlus 16T is expected to be in the works as a successor to the OnePlus 15T. It could come with a 6.35-inch 1.5K LTPO OLED display and a Dimensity 9600M chipset. The OnePlus 16T may feature a dual rear camera unit comprising two 200-megapixel sensors. The battery capacity is expected to be more than 7,000mAh. The OnePlus 15T was released in China in March this year.
title: OnePlus 16T Specifications Leaked; Tipped to Feature Dimensity 9600M Chipset, Dual 200-Megapixel Cameras

description: Apple’s MacBook Pro arrives in two flavours this year. The first one is your basic MacBook Pro with a standard display while the second is the MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR display that supports touch input. The second model has now shown up on benchmarking website Geekbench revealing the performance of its M5 Pro chipset.
title: MacBook Pro With PROLED XDR Display and M5 Pro Chip Visits Geekbench Revealing Performance Figures

description: Apple has revealed that the tech giant recorded its record revenue in India in Q4 2026. Apart from India, the iPhone maker also reported strong financial performance in other emerging economies and developed markets. Apple’s Q4 2026 revenue from iPhone sales grew by 17 percent to $57.6 billion (roughly Rs. ), “despite supply and foreign exchange” challenges. Ternus said that Apple also recorded double-digit revenue growth in the US and Greater China. The new CEO, who took charge on September 1, attributed the all-time high financial performance to upgraders globally, including those in the US, Mainland China, and India. This also helped the company post record-high revenue from buyers upgrading to the newer-generation iPhone models, the most recent being the iPhone 18 Pro series, which launched on September 9, along with the iPhone Duo.
title: Apple Reports ‘All-Time Record’ High Revenue in India in Q4 2026 on the Back of Strong iPhone Upgrades and Mac Sales

description: OpenAI announced in September that it planned to reduce the usage limits for select ChatGPT Pro subscriptions without reducing the price tag. The company now seems to be reversing its decision. In a statement, an OpenAI official has revealed that it will double usage limits for several ChatGPT Pro subscriptions. The revised limits are also said to be applicable to Business Premium. OpenAI will also continue to offer extended usage limits for its personal AI agents.
title: OpenAI Doubles ChatGPT Pro, Business Premium Usage Limits After Subscriber Feedback

description: Apple is reportedly working on a new HomeView smart home hub called HomeView Ultra, which could feature a larger display. It could arrive as early as next year, although its launch may be delayed until 2028. The upcoming model features a motorised robotic arm that can swivel and move the screen around a room. It will reportedly be priced at around $1,000 (roughly Rs. 90,000). The final price may vary depending on component costs and market conditions.
title: Apple HomeView Ultra With 9-Inch Display, Robotic Arm Said to Be in the Works; Price, Launch Timeline Tipped

description: Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon was the second best at performing agentic tasks on SemiAnalysis' recently released GDPx benchmark test. The frontier AI model managed to score 10.9 percentage points, which was slightly lower than the 12-percentage-point score of Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5. While Google’s AI model came in second position, it was significantly more cost-efficient than the Claude Opus 5.5 AI model. With 5,94,000 total output tokens, the Gemini 4 Carbon frontier AI model completed each task at $16.29. Meanwhile, Anthropic’s AI model cost $51.41 per task with a total of 5,48,000 output tokens.
title: Gemini 4 Carbon Frontier AI Model Falls Slightly Behind Claude Opus 5.5 in Agentic Capabilities, but Not in Cost Efficiency

description: Vivo's latest TWS earbuds use a clip-style design with a flexible titanium alloy bridge instead of conventional in-ear tips. The Buds Clip support several audio codecs, including LDAC, AAC, SBC and LC3, and offer DeepX 5.0 stereo sound, spatial audio and custom EQ settings. They can connect to three devices simultaneously and include real-time translation when paired with compatible Vivo and iQOO devices. Other features include wide-area touch controls, Find My Earbuds and AI-powered call noise reduction.
title: Vivo Buds Clip Launched Globally With Real-Time Translation Support, Up to 42 Hours of Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Google announced the expansion of its experimental Dreambeans app to India on Tuesday. With this move, the Mountain View-based tech giant brings its AI-powered personalised story collections to users aged 18 and above. According to Google, the app can create daily visual stories based on information from selected Google services, including Gmail, Calendar, Photos, Search, Gemini and YouTube. Dreambeans is part of the Google Labs experiment and is currently available on Android and iOS.
title: Google Dreambeans App Launched in India With AI-Powered Personalised Daily Stories

description: The Asus Jelly75 KD201 features a 75 percent layout, 4mm linear switches, gasket mounting, hot-swappable switches, Bluetooth and 2.4GHz wireless connectivity, USB-C, and a 4,000mAh battery. Check out the review to know more about the latest mechanical keyboard from Asus.
title: Asus Jelly75 KD201 Review: A Stylish Mechanical Keyboard That Gets the Basics Right
